key: You're not with Team Meteor, right?
en: You're not with Team Meteor, right?
ja: あなた、メテオ団の人じゃないですよね?

key: Please feel free to hide here.
en: Please feel free to hide here.
ja: ここに隠れていってくださって構いません。

key: With any luck, they won't bother disturbing us here.
en: With any luck, they won't bother disturbing us here.
ja: 運が良ければ、ここまでは邪魔しに来ないでしょう。

key: One of the grunts was heckling me with questions about this city...
en: One of the grunts was heckling me with questions about this city...
ja: 下っ端の一人に、この街のことをしつこく聞かれて……

key: I'm from Kalos; what do you expect me to know?!
en: I'm from Kalos; what do you expect me to know?!
ja: あたしカロス出身なのよ、知ってるわけないでしょ?!

key: Everyone's acting like this is a huge problem, but it's not like Team Meteor is actually hurting anything, right?
en: Everyone's acting like this is a huge problem, but it's not like Team Meteor is actually hurting anything, right?
ja: みんな大騒ぎしてるけど、メテオ団だって別に何か傷つけてるわけじゃないでしょ?

key: They rounded some of us up, interrogated some others, and are taking control...
en: They rounded some of us up, interrogated some others, and are taking control...
ja: 何人かを集めて、何人かを尋問して、支配下に置こうとしているだけで……

key: But if they wanted to harm us or the city, they already would have.
en: But if they wanted to harm us or the city, they already would have.
ja: でも本気であたしたちや街を傷つける気なら、もうとっくにやってるはずでしょ。

key: What's the big deal?
en: What's the big deal?
ja: 何がそんなに問題なわけ?

key: Tch, out of the frying pan and into the Fire Blast...
en: Tch, out of the frying pan and into the Fire Blast...
ja: ちっ、フライパンから逃げたと思ったら「だいもんじ」の中とはね……

key: I only just got in from the Circus and now this...
en: I only just got in from the Circus and now this...
ja: サーカスから戻ってきたばかりなのに、今度はこれだもの……

key: My boyfriend and a few others went out to fight against Team Meteor...
en: My boyfriend and a few others went out to fight against Team Meteor...
ja: あたしの彼氏と何人かが、メテオ団と戦うために出ていったの……

key: I hope they're all right...
en: I hope they're all right...
ja: みんな無事だといいけど……

key: I should've joined them!
en: I should've joined them!
ja: あたしも一緒に行くべきだった!

key: But!
en: But!
ja: でも!

key: I'm too scared!
en: I'm too scared!
ja: 怖すぎるの!

key: I'm awful...
en: I'm awful...
ja: あたし最低……

key: Team Meteor took my husband...
en: Team Meteor took my husband...
ja: メテオ団が夫を連れて行ったの……

key: Won't someone please do something?!
en: Won't someone please do something?!
ja: 誰か、何とかしてくれない?!

key: I've had a splitting headache ever since I woke up...
en: I've had a splitting headache ever since I woke up...
ja: 目が覚めてからずっと、頭が割れそうに痛くて……

key: What is even going on...?
en: What is even going on...?
ja: 一体何が起きてるの……?

key: Are they gone yet? Are they?!
en: Are they gone yet? Are they?!
ja: もういなくなった? もう?!
